children: FMC Corp reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $105.9 million, down 80.5% from $542.2 million a year earlier, and a net loss attributable to FMC stockholders of $2.07 billion, compared with a $569.3 million loss in the prior-year quarter. Diluted loss per share was $15.54.
¹ Reported as “Revenue”. ² Reported as “Net income (loss) attributable to FMC stockholders”. ³ Reported as “Diluted earnings (loss) per common share attributable to FMC stockholders”.
Weak demand and reduced channel replenishment weighed on sales. Revenue excluding India declined 89%.
Pricing adjustments on select channel-held products and a revised North American pricing and rebate model contributed to lower quarterly sales.
North America and Latin America were sharply weaker. Asia revenue increased amid prior-year actions related to preparation for an India sale, but declined excluding India.
Generic competition, pricing pressure and registration losses affected core products, while growers’ strained margins further softened demand.
Project Foundation targets $200 million in annual savings by the end of 2027. FMC said commercial actions and manufacturing changes are intended to support competitiveness.
